quote:
10 Proposed Charter Amendment
Conneaut City
A majority affirmative vote is necessary for
passage.
Shall the Charter of the City of Conneaut be
amended to add Article XVI to read as follows:
ARTICLE XVI CONSERVATION OF
NATURAL RESOURCES
Section XVI-1. Prohibition of Construction
of a Data Center
(A)The construction of a data center is hereby
prohibited. 
(B)As used in this Section, “construction” shall
mean the erection of one or more buildings,
infrastructure, facilities, and related activities,
which include preparations and modifications
for same, for a common purpose. 
(C)As used in this Section, “data center” shall
mean one or more buildings or physical
facilities or infrastructure, located on a single
real property parcel or on contiguous, adjacent,
or otherwise aggregated real property parcels
that (1) Are used primarily or exclusively for
digital information services such as the
management, storage, processing, and
dissemination of electronic data and
information through the use of computer
systems, servers, networking equipment, and
related components, including equipment
cooling systems; and (2) Has an aggregate
monthly demand or peak load of greater than
twenty five (25) megawatts, however derived
from any energy source, or a combination
thereof. 
(D) This Section is self-executing.

Notwithstanding 1 M.R.S. § 302, or any law to the contrary, and regardless of the date of its

enactment, this moratorium shall apply retroactively to any and all proceedings or applications

filed on or after November 3, 2026. It shall stand repealed as of six (6) months following its

enactment unless extended for one or more terms of not more than 180 days if the Select Board

finds that the need for the moratorium still exists and reasonable progress is being made to

alleviate the need for the moratorium as stated in Section 19.3.

This moratorium does not apply to routine maintenance, repair, or replacement of existing

equipment within a lawfully existing structure that does not enlarge or expand a Data Center

use, nor to municipal, school, or public safety information technology infrastructure operated by

the Town or another governmental entity for its own governmental purposes.

effect.

quote:
To add the following definition to Article 3:

DATA CENTER Any facility, building, structure, or portion thereof whose primary use is the

centralized storage, processing, or transmission of digital data for commercial or third-party

purposes. A Data Center includes, but is not limited to, cryptocurrency mining facilities, server

farms, cloud computing facilities, or colocation centers that rely on specialized infrastructure

such as industrial-scale cooling systems, backup generators, high-capacity electrical equipment,

or similar systems necessary to sustain continuous (24/7) operation of computer systems. This

term shall not include computers, servers, routers, or information technology equipment used

solely to support on-site activities of a lawful business or institutional use; or personal or

household server equipment accessory to a residential use.

To amend Article 5.3.C. by adding a line for “Data Centers” and marking it as Not Allowed in all

zones.
